# LocksMitch

> LocksMitch is a mobile auto locksmith in North Atlanta, Georgia, based in Cumming (Forsyth County). The owner, Mitch, comes to the car and cuts and programs keys on the spot: all keys lost, spare keys, smart keys and fobs, key programming and car lockouts. Answered 24/7. Phone and text: (770) 270-3333. Website: https://locksmitch.com

## Key facts
- Business: LocksMitch, a registered DBA of TPVision LLC. Mobile service only, no storefront.
- Locksmith: Mitch, the owner, does every job himself. No call center, no dispatcher.
- Hours: 24/7, including nights, weekends and holidays. Nights (9 pm to 7 am) add $50.
- Pricing: the price is quoted before driving out and does not change at the car. Coming to the customer is included, no separate trip fee.
- Second key for the same car in the same visit: 50% off. Booking online at https://locksmitch.com/book/: $15 off (spare keys and all keys lost only).
- Payment: cash, cards, Apple Pay, Zelle, Venmo, Cash App.
- Warranty: 1 year. If a key LocksMitch made or programmed stops working within a year, it is fixed or replaced free. Not covered: physical or water damage, lost keys, batteries. On a key the customer supplied, the programming is covered, not the part.
- Registered with NASTF for access to manufacturer key data.
- Vehicle: a Tesla Model Y with the LocksMitch logo.

## Starting prices (Cumming and Forsyth County)
Full list: https://locksmitch.com/pricing/

### Lockout and new keys
- Car lockout, flat rate: from $75. Opening the car with lockout tools, no damage. $75 in Cumming and Forsyth, $100 up to 25 miles, $125 up to 40 miles. A child or pet locked inside a car: opened free, any time, anywhere in the service area.
- Key cut, no chip: from $75. Plain metal key for older cars, doors and trunks, cut by code, by lock or from your working key.
- Spare key with chip: from $140. Transponder key cut and programmed, most makes.
- Key with remote (flip key): from $150. Remote head or flip key, cut and programmed.
- Push-to-start smart key: from $180. Proximity key programmed. 2020 and newer from $200.
- All keys lost: from $190. New key made from the vehicle code when no key is left. Toyota, Honda, Ford, GM, Hyundai, Kia, Nissan, Jeep and most other makes. Subaru and European makes quoted by model.

### Programming and remotes
- Programming only, a key you bought: from $99. We cut and program a key or fob you already have. Push-to-start smart key $129. No working key at all: all-keys-lost pricing applies. European makes quoted by model.
- Remote you bought, buttons only: from $89. Programming a remote without a key blade.
- Replacement remote: from $129. New remote supplied and programmed.

### Quick fixes, 24/7
- Jump start: from $75. Dead car battery, jump starter brought to the car. $75 in Cumming and Forsyth, $100 up to 25 miles, $125 up to 40 miles.
- Broken key extraction: from $75. Broken piece removed from the ignition or a door lock; a new key is priced separately.
- Key fob not working: from $75. New fob battery and a check of the key; free during another job.
- Erase a lost key: from $89. The lost key is removed from the car's memory; free with a new key from LocksMitch.

### European makes
- European: BMW, Mini, VW, Audi: from $200. Cut and programmed, model years we cover.
- Land Rover, Jaguar: from $350, 2011 and newer. All keys lost quoted by model.
- Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Volvo: from $450. Complex key systems, quoted by model.

## Service area
Cumming, Forsyth County and Sugar Hill (up to 12 miles by road): prices as listed.
12 to 25 miles (Buford, Suwanee, Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Duluth, Flowery Branch, Milton, Dawsonville, Roswell, Gainesville, Lawrenceville, Canton, Dunwoody): lockout and no-chip key $100, key jobs as listed.
25 to 40 miles (Peachtree Corners, Sandy Springs, Norcross, Braselton, Woodstock, Doraville, Smyrna): lockout and no-chip key $125, key jobs +$50.
Beyond 40 miles (Marietta, Kennesaw and further): quoted by Mitch.

## How to get help
- Call or text (770) 270-3333. An assistant answers 24/7 and passes the request to Mitch, who texts the exact price.
- Free estimate form on any page of https://locksmitch.com
- Online booking: https://locksmitch.com/book/
